## metasurvey — Reproducible Survey Processing
::: {.justify}
R package for integrating and analyzing survey data from multiple sources. Currently under review at [rOpenSci](https://github.com/ropensci/software-review/issues/752). It provides a step-based pipeline for reproducible survey data processing, built on top of the `survey` package for complex sampling designs.

- Lazy step pipeline (`step_compute`, `step_recode`, `step_rename`, `step_remove`, `step_join`) that preserves sampling design metadata through every transformation.
- Recipe system for packaging transformation pipelines into portable, versioned objects with metadata and dependency tracking.
- Transpiler for STATA `.do` files that converts legacy institutional processing scripts into reproducible R pipelines.
- REST API and Shiny explorer for publishing, discovering, and sharing recipes across research teams.
- 90%+ test coverage, 25 vignettes (English and Spanish), R CMD check with 0 errors/warnings.

## Spark de Ideas — Blog & Podcast
::: {.justify}
Technical blog and podcast in Spanish about Databricks, Data Engineering, MLOps, and data architecture. Includes the **Databricks Tips** series (9 posts and growing) with hands-on labs that readers can run in their own workspace.

- Blog built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and published on GitHub Pages.
- Diagrams generated with R + ggplot2, reproducible code in every post.
- Hands-on labs deployable with [Databricks Asset Bundles](https://docs.databricks.com/en/dev-tools/bundles/index.html).
- Podcast on [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/20WqZma0iLDYbg9wAEfv0w) with episodes about books, tools, and careers in data.
